notes.title: 4 Players & Firing Range! 🤯
notes.content: [h2]We've added support for up to 4 players! Also, a new Firing Range is now available — a carefree zone to have fun with no penalties.[/h2][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes:  [/h1][p]— Fixed an issue with the store in single-player mode;[/p][p]— Performed major network optimizations to prevent game crashes (if you were experiencing any);[/p][p]— Adjusted Shadow Quality settings; [/p][p]— Fixed an issue where aiming in third-person view caused control issues (aiming is now disabled while in third-person mode);[/p][p]— Fixed various other bugs![/p][p][/p][h1][b]Our Goal - 50 Reviews! 🤩[/b][/h1][p]If you've been enjoying the game, we'd greatly appreciate a Steam review. It helps us out a ton![/p][h3][b]A huge thank you to everyone who has already left a review! ❤️[/b][/h3][p][/p][h2][b]Good luck with your work at B.A.N.K.![/b][/h2]

notes.title: Big Update and Bug Fixes!
notes.content: [h2]We added hats![/h2][p]— Added new screamers.    [/p][p][/p][h1][b]Fixed bugs:[/b]  [/h1][p]— There were some problems with server connection, hopefully we've fixed them;[/p][p]— Items no longer disappear in the elevator;[/p][p]— Fixed a bug where it was impossible to exchange items for coins in single player; [/p][p]— Fixed some other bugs as well![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Happy working in B.A.N.K.![/b][/h2]
